name: agent-headless
description: One typed headless interface for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity CLIs.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/cli.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test:unit: bun test test/adapters.test.ts test/runtime.test.ts test/validation.test.ts test/live.test.ts
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run build && bun run test:package
scripts.check: bun run test:types && bun run test
scripts.smoke: bun run build && bun run test:package
